metas.name: Ambanja - Blue shirt
metas.note: The coverage in Ambanja can be recognized by a person wearing a dark blue T-shirt and black sunglasses.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Ambiky - Many palms, brown sandy dirt
metas.note: Ambiky can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the brown, sandy dirt road. In most of the coverage, there is a person walking in front of the trekker with a grey T-shirt and a brown backpack.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Andavadoaka - Greyish hat, red and white shirts
metas.note: The town of Andavadoaka can be recognized by three different people appearing on the coverage; One wearing a greyish hat and a light blue shirt, and two with red and white T-shirts.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Antananarivo - Hill
metas.note: Most of the coverage in Antananarivo was taken on the side of a hill looking out over the city, which leads up to the Queen’s Palace, which can be seen near the top of the hill.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Baobabs - Baobab Trees
metas.note: Baobab Avenue is easy to recognize by the extremely broad trunked baobab trees along the side of the road.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Beach west of Ambiky - Low trees and Low mountains
metas.note: A beach west of Ambiky can be recognized by the low trees combined with low mountains to the northwest.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Belo sur Mer - White sand
metas.note: Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the large number of palms combined with the blanket of white sand on the ground.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Belo sur Mer Beach - Dirty Sand
metas.note: The beach outside Belo Sur Mer can be recognized by the somewhat dirty sand and the curved shoreline with the ocean to the northwest.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Kirindy Mitea - Red soil
metas.note: Kirindy Mitea National Park can be most easily recognized by having the reddest soil present on Street View in Madagascar.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Manahy  - Large grass field
metas.note: A piece of coverage, partly taken on a large grassy field, and partly on the side of a sand dune, can be found south of Manahy.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Manahy - Barely Visible Roof Rack
metas.note: A car with a barely visible grey metal roof rack can be seen by Manahy. There are some locations where the car is completely blurred out, where the shape of the blur is the best indication of the area.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Morondava - Bald
metas.note: Morondava is most easily recognized by the bald person wearing either a light green or a light red striped shirt. It is also one of few towns where the trekker walks on a paved road.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Morondava Beach - Smooth sand
metas.note: Morondava has a very smooth sand beach, with the ocean to the northwest. There are a large number of palms visible. A man in a blue shirt can also be a clue for this beach.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: North of Andavadoaka  - Sandy Village
metas.note: A small, very sandy village with the shore to the north can be seen on a small cape north of Andavadoaka. Part of the coverage was taken just outside the shoreline.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: North of Andavadoaka - East shore
metas.note: A village with the shore to the east can be found north of Andavadoaka.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Northeast Andavadoaka - Light blue shirt
metas.note: A second Trekker, going to the northeast of Andavadoaka can be recognized by a person with a light blue T-shirt.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Northern Atoll - Sand
metas.note:
A couple of atolls on the central west coast can be seen on Street View. The northernmost is the smallest, and is easily recognizable as it only consists of sand and you can always see from one shore to the other.

NOTE: Among the five atolls with land coverage, only the two furthest south appear on the map.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Nosy Ambariovato - Blue shirt and sunglasses, Light red shirt, Dark red tank top
metas.note:
The coverage on the island of Nosy Ambariovato can be recognized by the people, one wearing a blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead, one with a light red T-shirt and one with a darker red tank top. There is also a fourth person in some of the coverage, wearing a light blue T-shirt. The coverage is very hilly and forested.

There is a village by the northern shore of Nosy Ambariovato.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: RN - Trekker
metas.note: The trekker next to the RN8 can be recognized by its extreme dryness, combined with the four people wearing red, blue, grey and light blue respectively.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Sambirano River  - Red shirt white cap, spotted dress
metas.note: A small section of the coverage by the Sambirano river has two different people present on the coverage; one with a red T-shirt and white cap, and one with a spotted dress.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Sambirano River - Blue shirt and sunglasses
metas.note: There are three major sections of coverage along the Sambirano river, most of which can be identified with the single person, wearing a dark blue T-shirt and sunglasses on their forehead. The same person is also present on Nosy Ambariovato.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Silver Roof Rack - RN-8
metas.note: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large silver roof rack on the Street View car. The coverage is very dry and sandy.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: South of Ambiky - Green Bushes
metas.note: An area with coverage south of Ambiky can be recognized by the large, solitary green bushes combined with a very slight red tinge in the dirt. Certain parts of the coverage are quite wet.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: South of Andavadoaka - Cow
metas.note:
A blue cart dragged by a black cow on the left and a brown-white cow on the right can be found south of Andavadoaka (First Image).

Another cart dragged by a white cow on the left and a black and white cow on the right can be found just south of Andavadoaka (Second Image).
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: St Augustin - Yellow tank top, blue shirt
metas.note:
Two pieces of coverage can be recognized by two people following the trekker; one with a yellow tank top and one with a blue T-shirt. The first of these two parts is located in the town of St Augustin (First image).

The second part with the same two people is found to the east of St Augustin, going through a hilly landscape with a lot of shrubs (Second Image).
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Surrounding Andavadoaka - Greyish hat, yellow shirt
metas.note: The main part of the trekker coverage surrounding Andavadoaka can be recognized by either the person wearing a greyish hat and light blue shirt or a person wearing a yellow T-shirt.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Toliara - No Person
metas.note: Toliara can be recognized as being a generally quite busy-looking town and the only large town on Madagascar with no person following the trekker.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Tsaranoro  - Mountains, Rainbow
metas.note: A small settlement is found in the northeastern end of Tsaranoro. The mountains can typically be seen in the background. A rainbow can also be seen in this area.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tsaranoro Massif - Beautiful Mountain view
metas.note: The Tsaranoro Massif is a large monolithic mountain with trekker coverage. The steep mountainsides, combined with the mountainous area surrounding the coverage makes it very recognizable. The four people following the trekker can also occasionally be a useful clue.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.
